title: Power Consumption Calculation
statementMd:
Tom is interested in power consumption of his favourite laptop. His laptop has three modes. In normal mode laptop consumes $*P*_{1}$ watt per minute. $*T*_{1}$ minutes after Tom moved the mouse or touched the keyboard for the last time, a screensaver starts and power consumption changes to $*P*_{2}$ watt per minute. Finally, after $*T*_{2}$ minutes from the start of the screensaver, laptop switches to the "sleep" mode and consumes $*P*_{3}$ watt per minute. If Tom moves the mouse or touches the keyboard when the laptop is in the second or in the third mode, it switches to the first (normal) mode. Tom's work with the laptop can be divided into $*n*$ time periods $[*l*_{1}, *r*_{1}], [*l*_{2}, *r*_{2}], ..., [*l*_{*n*}, *r*_{*n*}]$. During each interval Tom continuously moves the mouse and presses buttons on the keyboard. Between the periods Tom stays away from the laptop. Find out the total amount of power consumed by the laptop during the period $[*l*_{1}, *r*_{*n*}]$.

## Input

The first line contains 6 integer numbers $*n*$, $*P*_{1}$, $*P*_{2}$, $*P*_{3}$, $*T*_{1}$, $*T*_{2}$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 0 ≤ *P*_{1}, *P*_{2}, *P*_{3} ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *T*_{1}, *T*_{2} ≤ 60$). The following $*n*$ lines contain description of Tom's work. Each $*i*$-th of these lines contains two space-separated integers $*l*_{*i*}$ and $*r*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ 1440$, $*r*_{*i*} < *l*_{*i* + 1}$ for $*i* < *n*$), which stand for the start and the end of the $*i*$-th period of work.

## Output

Output the answer to the problem.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
Tom 对他最喜欢的笔记本电脑的功耗很感兴趣。这台笔记本电脑有三种模式。在普通模式下，笔记本电脑每分钟消耗 $*P*_{1}$ 瓦特。Tom 上次移动鼠标或触碰键盘后的 $*T*_{1}$ 分钟时，屏幕保护程序启动，功耗变为每分钟 $*P*_{2}$ 瓦特。最后，从屏幕保护程序启动后的 $*T*_{2}$ 分钟起，笔记本电脑切换到“睡眠”模式，每分钟消耗 $*P*_{3}$ 瓦特。如果笔记本电脑处于第二种或第三种模式时，Tom 移动鼠标或触碰键盘，它就会切换到第一种（普通）模式。

Tom 使用笔记本电脑的过程可以分为 $*n*$ 个时间段 $[*l*_{1}, *r*_{1}], [*l*_{2}, *r*_{2}], ..., [*l*_{*n*}, *r*_{*n*}]$。在每个时间段内，Tom 会持续移动鼠标并按下键盘按键。在这些时间段之间，Tom 会离开笔记本电脑。请计算在时间段 $[*l*_{1}, *r*_{*n*}]$ 内笔记本电脑消耗的总功耗。

## 输入

第一行包含 6 个整数 $*n*$、$*P*_{1}$、$*P*_{2}$、$*P*_{3}$、$*T*_{1}$、$*T*_{2}$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100, 0 ≤ *P*_{1}, *P*_{2}, *P*_{3} ≤ 100, 1 ≤ *T*_{1}, *T*_{2} ≤ 60$）。接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述 Tom 的工作情况。第 $*i*$ 行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $*l*_{*i*}$ 和 $*r*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ 1440$, *r*_{*i*} < *l*_{*i* + 1}$，其中 $*i* < *n*$），分别表示第 $*i*$ 个工作时间段的开始时间和结束时间。

## 输出

输出题目的答案。
</statement>
